subject.title: Clarify status of optional bird transport

question: Should Birdclaw restore and publicly support the `bird` package, or should setup guidance recommend `xurl` and mark `bird` legacy or currently unavailable?
rationale: Current code proves that Birdclaw can use both transports, but only the package owner can determine whether the deprecated external distribution remains an endorsed product dependency.

options.title: Recommend xurl now
options.body: Keep any needed compatibility code, but direct new users to `xurl` and clearly mark `bird` legacy or unavailable until a maintained distribution is public.

options.title: Restore bird distribution
options.body: Publish the authoritative maintained package and repository, repair the documentation links, and retain the dual-transport recommendation.

recommendation.title: Recommend xurl now
recommendation.body: Keep any needed compatibility code, but direct new users to `xurl` and clearly mark `bird` legacy or unavailable until a maintained distribution is public.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns Birdclaw and the affected package namespace and authored the current release guidance, so he can authoritatively set the support commitment.
